support_fixed_dkw_calculation.interpretation: Corrected formula arithmetic only; no post-selection guarantee for this chosen arm.

findings: The selected candidate was ranked using calibration outcomes, then reported with a floor computed from the same calibration sample; the fixed-candidate split-conformal statement does not cover this post-selection procedure.

The former DKW mean floor multiplied epsilon by the observed calibration range. The support-fixed [0,1] arithmetic result is recorded in guarantee.mean_floor_dkw; DKW also requires iid sampling, which is not established for these spatial blocks.
Repeated random partitions reuse the same block observations and are sensitivity diagnostics, not independent validation samples.
